name: Lyric note run (Argo Workflows)
notes: LIVE-GATED SKETCH — the note-DAG dogfood expressed as pure config; no code change is needed to run it, only the deferred live prerequisites below. A Lyric note run IS an Argo Workflow DAG (a step pod exits 0 => the DAG advances). pb submits workflow.json (nonce-stamped), observes THAT run to a terminal phase, binds the step-pod imageID to code_identity.image_digest, and taps the persisted note-run marker OUT-OF-BAND keyed on the run-nonce. BLOCKERS (all gate the LIVE leg, none the unit gate): (1) a headless service-account kubeconfig for one lyriclet namespace (doc §9 Q1); (2) the k8s-exec store tap ENGINE is not built — it must be a store-DIRECT kubectl-exec read (mongosh/psql into the datastore pod / a read replica), nonce-keyed, and must THROW rather than fall back to an app-API read (requiredFix 4); (3) the SECRET-nonce split — the value that round-trips into the STORE must be a high-entropy k8s Secret mounted into the step pod, NEVER the plaintext workflow parameter used here (which is honest only on a trusted-tenant cluster; requiredFix 1); (4) F2 — re-read the SHA<->digest mapping from a source independent of the CI/GitOps ref at drive time; (5) F3 — a lineage/readiness veto must precede any live drive on a lyriclet; (6) probe one real note-run Workflow to confirm which container carries the PR code (here 'main', the Argo pod container) before trusting the digest selector (Unknown 2). The conjure fields are UNUSED for argo (the cluster is the environment) — present only to satisfy pb-recipe-v1; the live environment provider supersedes them.

front_door.serves: documentation only — the argo drive submits workflow.json; there is no user-facing front-door URL for a note-run DAG

drive.reason: a Lyric note run executes as an Argo Workflow DAG — pb submits a nonce-stamped Workflow CR and observes THAT run out-of-band (LIVE-GATED)
